method: Read the flagged source line plus two lines of context for each diagnostic (sed -n) and grep for the referenced class or handler. No file was edited.

verdicts.hypothesisAsWritten: Label elements lack a for/id pairing or a nested control.

split.fixDirection: Give each control an id and point the label's for at it, or nest the control.
Per site: associate with the control it names, or change the element to a non-label (for example a span or a fieldset legend). A single id fix does not fit all five.

verdicts.hypothesisAsWritten: Clickable containers have no keyboard handler or role.
evidence: src/lib/components/ui/gaming/n64/Switch.svelte:193:3 opens the element that carries role="switch" (line 213), tabindex and onclick (line 216). The role and tabindex exist. No onkeydown or onkeyup is present, so the missing piece is the key handler.
src/lib/components/ui/gaming/n64/Select.svelte:173:13 is a span with onclick, role="button" and tabindex="0". The role exists here too. No key handler is present.
verdicts.correctedHypothesis: Both elements have an onclick with no keyboard handler. The role is already present on both.

verdicts.hypothesisAsWritten: The .tab-bar and .tab rules no longer match any markup.
evidence: src/routes/(app)/demos/client-inference/+page.svelte:20 is the only tab-related class in markup (tab-content).
The strings tab-bar, .tab and .tab.active do not occur outside the style block lines 69-100.
verdicts.note: The four selectors are .tab-bar (69), .tab (79), .tab:hover (96) and .tab.active (100). Removing the rules or restoring the markup both clear them. Pick one after checking whether the tabs were meant to exist.

verdicts.hypothesisAsWritten: A vendor-prefixed line-clamp is used without the standard property.
evidence: src/routes/(app)/admin/ai-dashboard/+page.svelte:559-561 sets display: -webkit-box and -webkit-line-clamp: 3. No standard line-clamp property is set.

notVerified: Behaviour in a browser (keyboard and screen-reader behaviour is inferred from the markup).
